items.title: 17.10 RC series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC through an RC series circuit (PDF 99-100).

blocks.text: Resistance R aur capacitor C AC source V se series mein jure hain (Fig 17.9 a). Dono se aik hi current guzarta hai. R par voltage VR = Irms R hai, current ke saath in phase; C par voltage VC = Irms XC = Irms / (wC), current se 90 darje peeche. Current ko hawala le kar VR current ki lakeer ke saath aur VC us ke amudan banaya jata hai (Fig 17.9 b). Lagaya voltage vector jor hai: Vrms = (VR^2 + VC^2) ka square root = Irms x (R^2 + (1/wC)^2) ka square root. Is liye impedance Z = Vrms / Irms = (R^2 + (1/wC)^2) ka square root (17.21).

blocks.alt: (a) AC source V ke saath series mein resistor R aur capacitor C; current I; dohre teer R par VR aur C par VC dikhate; chhote khaake VR ko I ke saath in phase aur VC ko I se 90 darje peeche dikhate. (b) Phasors: current I ki simt mein VR = Irms R, neeche 90 darje par VC = Irms XC, aur nateeja Vrms = Irms Z, I se theta zawiye par neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.9 (a), (b): (a) RC series circuit; (b) RC series circuit ke voltage phasors (kitab ki Figure 17.9 (a), (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yeh impedance diagram (Fig 17.9 c) R ko hawala simt mein aur XC ko amudan dikhata hai; Z un ka vector jor hai. Z aur R ke darmiyan zawiya theta voltage aur current ka phase farq hai: yahan current voltage se theta aage hai (Fig 17.9 d), jahan theta = tan^-1(XC/R) = tan^-1(1/(wCR)) = tan^-1(1/(2 pi f C R)).

blocks.alt: (c) Impedance diagram: R ufqi, XC neeche amudan aur Z wattar jo R se theta zawiya banata hai. (d) Voltage V aur current I, omega t 0 se 360 darje tak, aik hi period; I har nuqte par V se theta pehle pohanchta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.9 (c), (d): (c) RC series circuit ka impedance diagram; (d) RC series circuit mein voltage aur current ki waves (kitab ki Figure 17.9 (c), (d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 17.9 (d) mein current poora 90 darje aage aur voltage se mukhtalif frequency par bana hai. Series circuit mein dono ki frequency aik hi hoti hai, aur RC circuit mein current voltage se sirf zawiya theta aage hota hai (0 aur 90 darje ke darmiyan), jaisa impedance diagram (c) dikhata hai. Khaake mein yahi durust surat hai.

RC series circuit mein kharch taqat resistor ki wajah se hai, kyunke capacitor sirf tawanai jama karta aur zaya nahi karta: P = I^2 R, ya P = VI cos(theta) (17.22), jahan theta voltage aur current ka phase zawiya hai.

5 kilo-ohm resistor 5 uF capacitor ke saath series mein 220 V, 50 Hz AC source par jura hai. Phase zawiya maloom karein. Hal: theta = tan^-1(1/(2 pi f C R)) = tan^-1[1/(2 x 3.14 x 50 Hz x 5 x 10^-6 F x 5000 ohm)] = tan^-1(0.1273) = 7.25 darje.

blocks.prompt: Misal 17.6 mein impedance aur rms current maloom karein.

items: Current voltage se theta = tan^-1(1/(wCR)) aage.
Taqat sirf R mein: P = I^2 R = VI cos(theta).
